title: Basic Hits - 2 Weeks
description: Progressive training for JKD essentials: 22 Punches and 18 Kicks. Master them in manageable groups of 6.

days.notes: PUNCHES 1-6: Jab, Cross, Body Hooks, and Uppercuts. Focus on straight line principle.
PUNCHES 7-12: Lead/Rear Hooks, Body Jab/Cross, Swings. Learn to change levels.
PUNCHES 1-12: Full integration of the first 12 punches. Maintain balance during flow.
PUNCHES 13-18: OverHeads, Qua Chuies. Advanced angles and non-telegraphed entries.
PUNCHES 1-18: Continuous integration. Your punches should be getting faster and more relaxed.
PUNCHES 19-22: Final set. Marteau strikes and Lead OverHeads. Finalize the 22 punches series.
PUNCHES 1-22: Graduation day for punches. Flow through all 22 without hesitation.
REST DAY: Recovery and preparation for the 18 Kicks series.
KICKS 1-6: Jeet Tek, Hou Jeet Tek, Jik Tek, Hou Jik Tek, Nan Tek, Hou Nan Tek. Lead leg intercepting kicks.
KICKS 7-12: Juk Tek, Hou Juk Tek, Gwa Tek, Hou Gwa Tek, So Tek, Hou So Tek. Power side kicks and sweeps.
KICKS 1-12: Full integration of the first 12 kicks. Focus on hip stability.
KICKS 13-18: Jun Juk Tek, Jun Gwa Tek, Jun So Tek (and Hou versions). Spinning and advanced entries.
KICKS 1-18: Full integration of all kicks. Fluidity and timing are your goals.
TOTAL HIT MASTERY: Graduation Day! Flow through all 22 punches and 18 kicks.

Author: Antoine Giniès
